meta.receivedDateNote: supplier.final_containers.updated_at where status='completed' (the shipping container's close-out into inventory), falling back to supplier.invoices.ship_by_date. meta.sotNote: SOT = the component SKU exists in configurator.components_sot_skus (the synced SOT list). Matched on the SKU itself, never on its prefix.
meta.categoryNote: Category comes from the SKU prefix, longest prefix first. PH -> Pendant Lamp Holder and WS -> Wall Arm (resolved from the SOT source_tab). SKUs matching no rule are kept and shown as 'Other'.
meta.reasonNote: amazon_returns.reason 100% filled; ebay_returns.reason ~11%; shopify_returns has no reason column.
